title: 第十七章 发现真相第十八章 像一头嗜血的野兽
slug: 入梦撩拨我成了兽校顶级万人迷
content_zh:
月翎心顿时慌了。
雄性近在咫尺的审视目光落在她脸上，像要把那层皮肉都看穿。
她害怕自己泄露更多情绪，干脆垂下眼帘，睫毛轻轻颤动。
怎么办？
现在用精神力重新遮掩？
不行！
那样只会欲盖弥彰。
正慌乱间，腰间的力道忽然加重，她柔软的身躯跟着重重晃动几下。
月翎咬唇轻哼一声，知道他还在观察自己。
那一瞬间，她忽然想通了，闪躲很可能被发现，不如破罐子破摔。
她缓缓抬起了头，迎着雄性的目光娇媚一笑，惹得雄性更加发狠，也让自己彻底沉入其中……
＊＊＊＊＊＊
第二天大清早，月翎醒来时，整个人像被抽干了精气神，连手指都不想动。
但她还是咬着牙掀开被子，第一时间查看自己的精神域。
那圈淡绿色的光晕变得浓郁了不少，翠汪汪的，在精神域里缓缓流转，似乎随时都能突破下一阶。
她忍不住“哈”
地笑出声。
今天起得晚，宿舍里其他几个雌性已经收拾妥当，听到她的笑声，纷纷转头看过来。
“月翎，什么事这么高兴？”
罗珊主动开口，眼神不像前几天那样躲闪。

月翎自然察觉到她态度上的转变，眼神闪了闪，随口道：“我母亲说过段时间会来洛克郡看我。”
这话说完，罗珊的表情明显僵了一瞬。
月翎将她的反应看在眼里。
她当然看出罗珊不对劲。
故意这么说，不过是为了接下来一段时间的安宁。
罗珊不是怀疑自己是假的吗？
那她现在放出诺克郡家族身份显赫的雌性即将到来，罗珊就算怀疑什么，也得掂量掂量，不敢随意动作。
关上洗手间的门后，她想到昨晚风奕彻底放纵失控的模样，脸不受控制地烫了几分。
至于他看到了自己的脸……
月翎对着镜子里的自己说：别慌。
对于雄性而言，那只是一场梦。
梦里的脸是谁，甚至有没有脸，都不重要。
她之前用精神力遮掩容貌，不过是为了避免麻烦。
毕竟对方看到了，现实里难免会多关注两分，兴许就会暴露一些秘密。
可事情已经发生，只能往好了想。
content_en:
Yue Ling suddenly panicked.
The male's close and scrutinizing gaze fell on her face, as if he wanted to see through all the skin.
She was afraid that she would reveal more emotions, so she simply lowered her eyes and her eyelashes trembled slightly.
what to do?
Now use mental power to cover it up again?
no!
That would only cover up the truth.
While she was panicking, the force on her waist suddenly increased, causing her soft body to sway heavily.
Yue Ling bit her lip and hummed, knowing that he was still observing her.
At that moment, she suddenly figured out that if she dodged, she would probably be discovered, so it was better to break the jar and throw it.
She slowly raised her head and smiled coquettishly at the male's gaze, which made the male become even more aggressive and allowed herself to sink completely into it...
＊＊＊＊＊＊
Early the next morning, when Yue Ling woke up, her whole body seemed to have been drained of energy, and she didn't even want to move her fingers.
But she still gritted her teeth and lifted the quilt, and immediately checked her spiritual realm.
The light green halo became much thicker and green, slowly flowing in the spiritual realm, as if it could break through to the next level at any time.
She couldn't help but "ha"
laughed out loud.
I got up late today, and several other females in the dormitory had already packed up. When they heard her laughter, they all turned their heads to look over.
"Yue Ling, why are you so happy?"
Luo Shan took the initiative to speak, her eyes not as evasive as the previous few days.
Yue Ling naturally noticed the change in her attitude, her eyes flashed, and she said casually: "My mother said she would come to Rock County to visit me in a while."
After saying this, Luo Shan's expression visibly stiffened for a moment.
Yue Ling saw her reaction in his eyes.
Of course she could see something was wrong with Roxanne.
I said this deliberately, just for the sake of peace in the next period of time.
Didn’t Luo Shan suspect that she was fake?
Then she has released a female with a prominent status from the Knock County family and is about to arrive. Even if Roshan suspects something, she has to think carefully and not dare to act casually.
After closing the bathroom door, she thought of Feng Yi's completely indulgent and out-of-control appearance last night, and her face burned uncontrollably.
As for him seeing his own face...
Yueling said to herself in the mirror: Don't panic.
To the male, it's just a dream.
It doesn’t matter who the face in the dream is, or even whether it has a face.
She used mental power to hide her appearance before, just to avoid trouble.
After all, the other party has seen it. In reality, it is inevitable that he will pay more attention, and maybe some secrets will be exposed.
But things have happened, so we can only think for the better.
